customers.sectionSubtitle: Combining technical expertise with industry know-how, we help businesses navigate the technology maze in High Tech, Financial Services, Insurance, Energy & Utilities, Healthcare, iGaming, Aviation, Logistics, and others.

content.paragraph1: At Generix, we craft intelligent insurance software solutions that help organizations evolve, adapt, and thrive in a fast-changing world. With a strong presence across Europe and deep experience in insurance technologies, we specialize in driving innovation and delivering impactful results for insurance companies.
content.paragraph2: Our team combines top-tier engineering talent with insurance industry expertise to guide companies through complex digital transformations. Whether you're a small insurer looking to modernize or a large carrier seeking comprehensive solutions, we bring clarity and momentum to every challenge. We embrace an AI-first mindset in software development, while our platforms empower businesses to integrate artificial intelligence strategically—unlocking tangible value and accelerating performance.
content.paragraph3: With a proven track record of successful implementations across multiple countries, we've helped insurers of all sizes—from global carriers to regional providers—achieve meaningful growth and long-term success in the digital insurance landscape.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.text: Welcome to Generix. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.text: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:

personalInfo.title: Personal Information
personalInfo.text: This includes data that can be used to identify you such as your name, email address, phone number, and contact details that you provide when you register with us or submit inquiries through our contact forms.

nonPersonalInfo.title: Non-Personal Information
nonPersonalInfo.text: This includes information about how you use our website, including cookies, browser information, and usage patterns. This information helps us improve our website and services.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.text: We use the collected data for various purposes, including:
dataUsage.item1: To provide and maintain our service
dataUsage.item2: To notify you about changes to our service
dataUsage.item3: To provide customer support and respond to inquiries
dataUsage.item4: To improve our website and services

dataProtection.title: How We Protect Your Data
dataProtection.text: The security of your data is important to us. We have implemented measures to ensure that your information is not lost, misused, accessed, disclosed, altered, or destroyed. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure.

dataSharing.title: Information Sharing
dataSharing.text: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal data to third parties. We may share your information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business, as long as they agree to keep this information confidential.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.text: Under data protection laws, you have rights regarding your personal data, including:
userRights.item1: The right to access your personal data
userRights.item2: The right to request correction of inaccurate data
userRights.item3: The right to request deletion of your data
userRights.item4: The right to object to processing of your data

introduction.text: This document describes what cookies are used by the \"Generix Ltd.\" website, for what purpose they are collected, how they can be managed, and what external services are used.

cookieTypes.title: What types of cookies do we use?

byDuration.session: Session Cookies: Stored temporarily on your device while you browse the site. They are automatically deleted when you close your browser.
byDuration.persistent: Persistent Cookies: Stored for a specific period of time or until you manually delete them. They help us analyze site traffic and improve our services.

byOrigin.title: By origin:
byOrigin.firstParty: First-party cookies – set by our website.
byOrigin.thirdParty: Third-party cookies – set by external partners (e.g., analytics and marketing services).

byPurpose.title: By purpose:
byPurpose.essential: Essential cookies – necessary for proper functioning of the site.
byPurpose.security: Security cookies – protect user information and the site from abuse.
byPurpose.analytics: Analytics and marketing cookies – support site analysis and development, as well as personalized advertising.

externalServices.title: What external services does Generix Ltd. use?
externalServices.googleAnalytics: Google Analytics – for web analysis and statistics (data is stored on Google servers; Google's privacy policy is available online).
externalServices.googleAds: Google Ads/Adwords – for implementing advertising and remarketing campaigns, performance analysis.
externalServices.facebookPixel: Facebook Pixel – for analyzing the effectiveness of Facebook ads and creating specialized target audiences.
externalServices.note: Note: We do not collect personal data through these services, and information is anonymized according to the respective platform's policies.

managingCookies.title: How can you manage cookies?
managingCookies.text: Cookies can be controlled through browser settings or the appropriate button/form on our website. Limiting certain cookies may affect the site's functionality.
managingCookies.browserInfo: Instructions for managing cookies in major browsers are available on their official websites (Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome, Safari, etc.).

externalLinks.title: External links and cookies from other sites
externalLinks.text: The site may contain links to external pages (YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.). \"Generix Ltd.\" has no access to the cookies of these sites.

hero.label: Our Approach
hero.title: The Aurexia Bridge
hero.subtitle: A proprietary consultancy model connecting visionary developers with qualified investors.

distinction.label: Our Distinction
distinction.title: What Sets Us Apart
distinction.intro: We are not a traditional real estate agency. We are a strategic consultancy that adds value at every stage of the investment journey.

card1.title: Curated Excellence
card1.text: Every property in our portfolio undergoes rigorous due diligence — legal, financial, and architectural — before it earns our recommendation.

card2.title: Bilingual Expertise
card2.text: Our multilingual team ensures seamless communication between international investors and local developers, eliminating barriers.

card3.title: Investor Protection
card3.text: We represent our clients' interests exclusively, providing independent advisory with full transparency on fees and commissions.

step1.title: Initial Consultation
step1.text: We begin with a thorough understanding of your investment goals, risk profile, and lifestyle preferences.

step2.title: Market Analysis
step2.text: Our team conducts comprehensive research on target markets, identifying opportunities that align with your criteria.

step3.title: Property Curation
step3.text: We present a shortlist of pre-vetted properties, each accompanied by detailed investment analysis and projections.

step4.title: Due Diligence
step4.text: Complete legal, financial, and technical verification of the selected property, ensuring full compliance and transparency.

step5.title: Transaction & Beyond
step5.text: We manage the entire acquisition process and provide ongoing support for property management and portfolio optimization.

fee.label: Transparency
fee.title: Professional Fee Model
fee.intro: Our compensation is structured to align our interests with yours — ensuring that our success depends on your satisfaction.

point1.title: Success-Based Commission
point1.text: Our primary fee is a success-based commission, payable only upon the completion of a transaction.

point2.title: No Hidden Costs
point2.text: Full transparency on all fees and charges. You will always know exactly what you are paying for.

point3.title: Developer-Funded Model
point3.text: In most cases, our fee is covered by the developer, meaning zero additional cost to the investor.

cta.title: Ready to Invest with Confidence?
cta.text: Let us guide you through Europe's most compelling real estate opportunities.

hero.label: For Developers
hero.title: Strategic Partnership
hero.subtitle: Accelerate sales and reach qualified international investors through Aurexia's established network.

why.label: The Advantage

why.intro: We bring a qualified pipeline of investors directly to your developments, with a focus on premium positioning and accelerated sales.

item1.title: Qualified Investor Network
item1.text: Access our extensive network of pre-qualified high-net-worth investors actively seeking luxury real estate opportunities.

item2.title: Premium Brand Positioning
item2.text: Your developments are presented through our luxury brand platform, reaching clients who value exclusivity and quality.

item3.title: International Market Reach
item3.text: Multilingual marketing and sales support reaching investors across Western and Eastern Europe.

item4.title: Performance-Based Model
item4.text: Our fee structure is aligned with results — you pay for performance, not promises.

criteria.item1: Completed or near-completion projects with all permits and licenses
criteria.item2: Track record of delivering high-quality residential developments
criteria.item3: Transparent pricing with no hidden fees or surcharges
criteria.item4: Commitment to after-sales service and property management
